record.rationale: Task64 extends the existing shared reserved-slot adapter with erased native ValueT copy/move construction, in-place assignment, destruction, optional operator== and move-if-noexcept traits. All existing initialized vector helpers and std_vector operations preserve object ownership; copy/move constructor and assignment, rvalue append and destructor bindings reuse the same storage. Native selected libc++ whole streams compare object identities, values, capacities and every special-member event for both move traits, aliased append, all insertion branches, retained/reallocated assignment, empty operations and self copy/move. Borrowed scalar/pointer stores remain shared. This is language infrastructure, not a new mdds container or certified whole STL implementation. Custom allocators, throwing operator cleanup, invalid/self-inserting ranges, other standard-library implementations, physical ABI and complete mdds/Calc cell/document/UI remain unverified. Task65 connects actual initialized object ValueT ownership to the existing delayed_delete_vector/default_element_block operation family, reusing shared vector special-member helpers. Count/default constructs independent values; count/fill and range/copy perform actual value copies including hidden constructed prefixes. Reference assignment, append/lvalue emplace, range insertion, resize/default construction, erase, reserve/shrink, equality and destructor preserve original native operators. Original mdds block swap performs two copies and copy assignments; actual std::iter_swap remains a distinct move-temporary operation. Scalar and borrowed-pointer paths remain shared. Pure callers over unchanged mdds3.2.1 headers and full actual SharedString/CellTextAttr sources use verified existing complete native dependency objects and normal-only witness execution, comparing whole owned and Calc streams. Existing SharedString and CellTextAttr owners are reused; external mdds imports no Calc/SVL. Custom allocators/StoreT, throwing cleanup, undefined ranges/lifetimes, complete perfect-forwarding/rvalue overload families, physical ABI, pointee/callback/container/document/UI owners remain unverified.
responsibilities: Actual shared reserved/constructed slot syntax, unmanaged value/pointer copying and vector shift/assignment primitives without delayed/front or mdds segmentation policy.
Shared erased standard lower_bound partition-search syntax over existing real vector storage, with valid-range comparison ordering and no domain lookup or ownership policy.
Erased initialized ValueT special-member ownership across existing reserved vector operations, witnessed by whole original native caller streams; no separate allocator or domain container.
